name: Cat C9.3B
description: C9.3B, 340 bkW (456 bhp) @ 2000 rpm, IND-D rating, single-turbo TA (Turbocharged-Aftercooled), DOC+DPF+SCR aftertreatment.
notes: Geometry, compression ratio, and the full torque/power curve (600-2200 rpm, 17 points) are transcribed verbatim from Caterpillar's published spec sheet (doc SS-11138191-1000022860-051: bore 115mm, stroke 149mm, displacement 9.3L, compression ratio 17.0:1, max torque 2088 N·m @ 1400 rpm, max power 340 kW @ 2000 rpm, single Turbocharged-Aftercooled aspiration -- confirmed NOT twin-turbo, unlike the C18). The compressor map, VE curve, and turbine map coefficients are NOT independently dyno-validated for this engine -- no public compressor map exists for either engine in this project. They are derived by scaling the C18 reference coefficients by this engine's displacement ratio (9.3/18.1 ~= 0.514) for the flow-dependent terms, since a smaller single-turbo engine moves proportionally less air at a given RPM. Treat compressor/turbine pressure-ratio outputs as engineering estimates, not measured data.

zone_names: Zone 6 — Turbine Outlet / Pre-Aftertreatment (Turbo outlet → DPF inlet)

action_map.1: Inspect intake ducting between airflow meter and compressor inlet. Check hose clamps and silicone couplers.
action_map.2: Check boost pipe connections between compressor outlet and CAC inlet. Inspect for cracked charge pipes.
action_map.3: Inspect CAC-to-intake manifold connections. Check CAC end tanks and pipe clamps.
action_map.4: Inspect exhaust manifold gaskets and V-band clamps. Check turbocharger turbine housing bolts.
action_map.5: Inspect DPF/SCR connections. Check DOC mounting bolts and exhaust pipe V-bands.
action_map.6: Inspect turbine outlet-to-DPF inlet ducting and joints. Check for cracked/loose pre-aftertreatment piping.
